# `house_disclosure_reports`

**House disclosure report readings**

One explicitly selected P filing PDF reading, including refusals and the exact source/backend version.

**Coverage.** Sampled. One declared retained index snapshot and explicitly selected periodic transaction report originals. Other categories are discovery only; image-form extraction and source-wide completeness remain unqualified. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

**Data quality.** Native blanks, ranges, repeated index entries and original/amended observations remain separate. Refused reading is not a valid empty report. Page regions retain unqualified checkboxes; annual sections and scanned transactions are outside this pilot.

- **Parquet file:** `house_disclosure_reports.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `report_id` | `VARCHAR` | Identity binding a selected index observation to one exact original PDF version. |
| `filing_id` | `VARCHAR` | Identity of one original index line in one retained index snapshot; repeated DocIDs remain separate observations. |
| `doc_id` | `VARCHAR` | Literal House filing DocID; distinct from a native transaction ID. |
| `source_uri` | `VARCHAR` | Official URL of the selected original PDF. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the exact original PDF, separate from index and derived output hashes. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Recorded source capture instant; null when no supported capture time is known. |
| `extraction_status` | `VARCHAR` | native_layout for the declared native-cell reading, or refused with a reason; refused is not an empty filing. |
| `refusal_reason` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit unread, identity, layout or page-budget reason; null on a qualified native reading. |
| `parser_version` | `VARCHAR` | Version of the source-owned deterministic native-grid reader. |
| `backend` | `VARCHAR` | Native PDF backend used by the reader. |
| `backend_version` | `VARCHAR` | Installed native PDF backend version recorded for replay. |
| `model` | `VARCHAR` | Null: this path makes no model or OCR calls. |
| `filer_name_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Name stated by the native PDF, when readable; never inferred from an image refusal. |
| `state_district_raw` | `VARCHAR` | State/district stated by the native PDF, checked against the selected index for qualified native reports. |
| `signed_date_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Date printed beside the native digital-signature statement; this is not signature authentication. |
| `index_year` | `BIGINT` | Selected publisher index year, distinct from the date range of transaction activity. |
| `source_bytes` | `BIGINT` | Original PDF byte size. |
| `page_count` | `BIGINT` | Selected original PDF page count, including unread pages. |
| `transaction_count` | `BIGINT` | Qualified native transaction observations emitted for this selected report; zero with refusal does not establish no transactions. |
